mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO news_content (news_title, news_url, press, published_at) VALUES (#{newsTitle}, #{newsUrl}, #{press}, #{publishedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT nid, news_title AS newsTitle, news_url AS newsUrl, press, published_at AS publishedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM news_content WHERE news_title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%') ORDER BY published_at DESC

SELECT nid, news_title AS newsTitle, news_url AS newsUrl, press, published_at AS publishedAt, created_at AS createdAt FROM news_content WHERE published_at >= #{date} AND published_at < #{date} + INTERVAL 1 DAY ORDER BY nid DESC
